description: SDK-6948 language-neutral serializer capture contract. Capture app-owned values once per report, strip raw bytes from the resolved output, preserve serializer text under existing masking and capture controls, and keep base app-facing inputs. Named scenarios and observations are defined in FIXTURE-FORMAT.md.
base_parity_guards_note: Parked accounting repros are not serializer cases. Every SDK review runs these guards base-vs-head and requires head to match its accounting base. Source report paths are relative to the SDK-6948 handover directory, not executable fixture dependencies.

base_parity_guards.title: Cancelled wrappers and both unset-status twin orders keep base credits
Same-source repeat BYOK and fallback flags match base
Dated twin usage replacement and cost amounts match base
Legacy failed pending calls preserve explicit credits
Restored fractional latency and first-token timing match base
Claude 1-hour cache-write tokens and service tiers match base
Claude subagent result model attribution matches base
Application exceptions keep base app_error classification
